gloss: to give (charitably); to bless; to bestow

definitions.gloss: to give (charitably); to give alms; to show mercy
definitions.explanation: To give something to someone less fortunate out of compassion or charity.

definitions.gloss: to bless; to bestow; to be blessed with
definitions.explanation: For nature, fortune, or a higher power to grant favorable conditions or gifts. Often used in the passive form 恵まれる.

examples.japanese: {貧|まず}しい{人|ひと}に{食|た}べ{物|もの}を{恵|めぐ}む。
examples.english: To give food to a poor person.

examples.japanese: {道端|みちばた}で{物乞|ものご}いに{小銭|こぜに}を{恵|めぐ}んだ。
examples.english: I gave some coins to a beggar on the street.
Please show mercy. / Please give me alms.

examples.japanese: {天候|てんこう}に{恵|めぐ}まれた。
examples.english: We were blessed with good weather.

examples.japanese: {才能|さいのう}に{恵|めぐ}まれている。
{自然|しぜん}に{恵|めぐ}まれた{土地|とち}で{育|そだ}った{野菜|やさい}は{格別|かくべつ}だ。
examples.english: Vegetables grown on land blessed with natural beauty are exceptional.

notes:
The passive form {恵|めぐ}まれる (to be blessed with) is extremely common and used even more frequently than the active form. It expresses being fortunate or gifted with favorable circumstances.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {天候|てんこう}に{恵|めぐ}まれる: to be blessed with good weather
- {才能|さいのう}に{恵|めぐ}まれる: to be blessed with talent
- {環境|かんきょう}に{恵|めぐ}まれる: to be blessed with a good environment
- お{恵|めぐ}み: alms, charity (noun form)
- {恵|めぐ}みの{雨|あめ}: welcome rain, blessed rain

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {施|ほどこ}す: to give (charity), to perform — more formal, literary
- {与|あた}える: to give, to grant — neutral, does not imply charity
- {授|さず}ける: to bestow, to confer — more formal, implies granting from above
